snippet.title: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re going to WAR! Would you like to know more?

Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! releases today, and the Federation expects YOU to do your part, and sign up now with the mighty Mobile Infantry. The team of developers at Auroch Digital and Dotemu - overseen by FedDev - have been working tirelessly, to ensure all aspiring Citizens have a chance to make a difference.

Join the fight, NOW, to find:
- Intense, authentic retro FPS combat
- Bug Mode 
- Offline Play
- High-quality FMV 

Deploy NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321780/Starship_Troopers_Ultimate_Bug_War/

Join the fight on Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/starship-troopers-ultimate-bug-war/9p7rw7v55lf0

And Deploy now on PlayStation 5 : https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10016557

For Nintendo Switch 2 Troopers: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/Starship-Troopers-Ultimate-Bug-War--3046458.html

Follow on X (Twitter): https://x.com/UltimateBugWar
Follow on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/UltimateBugWar
